hypothesis: Expert test faults missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue are most likely to be discovered in the distal piedmont (2-8 km from any mapped trace), where regional compilations are least complete and USGS 3DEP lidar still resolves low-relief fault-scarp slope excess. A binary dot map ranked by lidar step_max over that distal domain is therefore a distinct, label-independent discovery surface.
mechanism: Quaternary normal faults that offset the surface leave a scarp: a short-wavelength slope excess (crest convexity / base concavity) measurable in lidar. step_max is the maximum band-passed step response in a 500 m neighbourhood, so it fires on scarp-like steps wherever they occur. Restricting to 2-8 km off the mapped catalogue targets the completeness gap of regional fault maps rather than re-mapping known traces.
named_non_fault_process: Pluvial Lake Lahontan shoreline / terrace risers and incised channel banks produce contour-parallel steps of similar 2-10 m scale near range fronts; roads, fan toes and mine benches also create steps. step_max responds to any step, so it is not fault-specific.
how_it_differs_from_repo: H79-NHR (canonical lane) trains a gradient booster on nested catalogue hides with a kernel-credit target and places dots near mapped faults. H33 prunes dots near mapped faults but still occupies the 200 m-2 km near-fault band. H79-FF uses no learned model, no catalogue-hide target, and places dots exclusively 2-8 km from mapped faults — a different domain, a single physical transform (lidar step_max), and no training on any fault labels.
placement: greedy descending rank, Euclidean 3 px Poisson spacing, fixed budget, off-catalogue, zeros elsewhere

leakage_canary.note: H79-FF is a fixed, non-learned surface (one physical transform, no training). There is no held-out label to leak from, so the learned-feature leakage canary does not apply. No projected leaderboard score is claimed.

holdout_dti.note: H79-FF is not trained on simulated discoveries, so the hide-and-recover holdout (gems57-pooled-hide-v2) does not produce a score for it. No HOLDOUT-DTI is written. This is a research artifact, not a promoted submission candidate.
